Purpose

The Born-Digital Processing Application assists archival staff with the initial processing of born-digital files and removable media.

The application supports tasks including:

  • Directory listings
  • File format identification
  • Byte-count reports
  • BagIt package creation
  • HTML and spreadsheet reporting
